verdict.rationale: Self-hosting an open-source voice agent runtime is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a managed service, run through the dashboard, API, CLI, or hosted MCP server, with code executing on ElevenLabs' infrastructure. Nothing in the pack shows open-source runtime code or a self-hosted deployment option.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
